install.title: Install ARVID on your iPhone
install.intro: Installed on the home screen, ARVID works offline and your data is protected. Without installing, Safari may delete it if you don't open it for a few days.
install.step2: Tap the **Share** button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
install.step3: Choose **Add to Home Screen** and confirm.
install.step4: Open ARVID from its icon, not from Safari.
install.note: Safari's data and the installed app's data are separate: start using it from the icon.
